[LGRA.22.4.1] **An unknown schema is refused.** The compiler must refuse, with
`DS_VALIDATE_UNKNOWN_SCHEMA`, a schema-reference site ([LGRA.22.4]) — a pattern
head, a `latest`, an `emit` or a `publish` — whose bare `NAME` is no schema in
local scope, or whose library-qualified reference names a schema the imported
library does not export ([LIMP.4.3.2]).
